science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
summary: Kaio bounds into the galley tracking mud, excited by a topographical discovery involving the ferrofluid sea, before abruptly handing the narrative baton to Ryn.
narrative_prose: Kaio's boots struck the basalt flooring of The Hearth, leaving a trail of glowing, mud-caked footprints in his wake. The exterior vistas of the Enclave Crater Valley had been a riot of bifurcated thermal shear, the wind whipping the resonant spore fog into swirling ribbons. Out there, the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea had carved impossible geometric waves, rolling like liquid obsidian under the twin suns' fading light. The sheer beauty of it had nearly driven him to sketch on the spot, tracing the geomagnetism with his brass sextant. But a sudden, jarring shift in the piezo-electric hum had warned him of a pressure wave, forcing him to scramble up a jagged basalt pinnacle just as a localized gravity eddy crushed the very outcrop he had been standing on—a reminder that the sanctuary didn't suffer daydreams without a cost. Inside, however, the galley hummed with a different sort of energy. The thirty-gallon steam-jacketed kettles gleamed with polished perfection, their copper surfaces reflecting the warm, flickering hearthfire. The scent of braised mire-lentils and roasted root-tubers enveloped the room, an irresistible, savory anchor against the wildness outside. Kaio couldn't resist (CONSUME) plucking a stray, slightly burnt crust from the butcher block, savoring the bitter-sweet crunch. He absentmindedly reached for a heavy brass ladle (DEFEND) to balance his pack, only to meet Ryn's fierce, hawk-like glare. Quickly, he moved to pull his tattered, mud-stained field journal tight against his chest (CONCEAL), trying to hide the fact that he was once again tracking wilderness straight into her immaculate sanctuary. 'I've got the map, Ryn! The whole shear pattern!' Kaio shouted, tossing the journal onto the pristine counter, effectively handing the moment over to her.
